prerequisites.name: Real owner workspace/watchlist
prerequisites.blocker_impact: Manual live monitoring cannot be confirmed against authentic owner workspace data.
prerequisites.next_owner_action: Open StockLedger with the real owner workspace/watchlist and confirm it is not synthetic; keep its contents private.

prerequisites.name: Permitted current completed-daily-bar input
prerequisites.blocker_impact: A compatible, fresh input with declared source/adjustment and confirmed use permission is required.
prerequisites.next_owner_action: Select a compatible current completed-daily-bar input, confirm the right to use it, and declare its source and adjustment basis.

prerequisites.name: Node runtime
prerequisites.blocker_impact: The worker runtime does not meet the Product minimum.
prerequisites.next_owner_action: Select or install Node 22.23.2 or newer for StockLedger worker operation.

prerequisites.name: Private worker SQLite path
prerequisites.blocker_impact: No owner-specific worker database was available to verify.
prerequisites.next_owner_action: Configure an owner-specific private worker SQLite database and verify that it is readable and writable.

prerequisites.name: Private local handoff folder
prerequisites.blocker_impact: No owner-specific worker handoff folder was available to verify.
prerequisites.next_owner_action: Choose an owner-specific private handoff folder and configure the worker to use it; verify read/write access and StockLedger handoff structure.

prerequisites.name: App folder grant
prerequisites.blocker_impact: The app may not be able to read or acknowledge worker handoff evidence.
prerequisites.next_owner_action: In StockLedger Settings, choose and grant the worker handoff folder, then confirm read/write access.

prerequisites.name: Private backup destination/cadence and restore
prerequisites.blocker_impact: Required recoverability has not been established.
prerequisites.next_owner_action: Configure a private backup destination and repeatable cadence, then restore one backup to an isolated temporary copy and validate it without overwriting live data.

prerequisites.name: Unattended monitoring (optional)
prerequisites.blocker_impact: No unattended schedule is configured; this does not block manual monitoring.
prerequisites.next_owner_action: No action unless unattended monitoring is intended; if intended, configure a StockLedger-specific schedule and confirm the worker path, awake-machine readiness, and readable input.

prerequisites.name: SMTP (optional)
prerequisites.blocker_impact: None; Today/Alerts is sufficient without SMTP.
prerequisites.next_owner_action: No action unless SMTP is desired; if desired, configure it server-side and verify presence without exposing values.
